description:
Jacob joins Luka in a 1,500 point narrative battle report.

The Tau are undergoing a routine troop rotation to the front line to attempt to break the typical Imperial war of attrition. Reports show the area as safe, and it has been used in the past, but the Catachan are the Devils of the jungle.
